plan_review.notes: Independent plan review identified the canonical lock metadata, docs-only install, and action-required race risks; all were addressed, with the plan remaining convergent.

rounds.notes: Review findings covered tarball provenance, dependency-scope wiring, docs-only setup, and admin-intervention false positives; all were fixed and re-reviewed.

PR-time review round: nanoid downgrade reintroduced a high-severity advisory, the ungated root postinstall downloaded Chromium on every job, the lock-integrity script failed lint on URL/fetch globals, the classifier expectation table was stale, and the admin-intervention exclusion keyed on a mutable workflow name. Each was independently revalidated by a different-model agent and fixed.

independent_grade.notes: The dependency integrity gate is correctly scoped and wired, fails closed on unverifiable metadata, validates canonical registry provenance and quarantine age, and includes focused decision-logic tests. The incident recovery extension is deliberate, explicitly requested work using existing infrastructure, not scope creep. Workflow and incident integration coverage is limited but reveals no actionable defect.
